name: critique
context_rationale: The skill orchestrates from the main agent thread — reads vault files, runs tools, gates build-slice, and halts on TRI-1 user input — while spawning a fresh-context 'critique' subagent for the adversarial heavy lifting.
summary: Adversarial review of the current slice's design by a separate Critic AI persona. Spawns a 'critique' subagent with 9 fixed attack dimensions, writes findings to critique.json, and gates /build-slice behind a user-owned TRI-1 triage step. Mandatory in Standard (medium/high tier) and Heavy modes; skippable on low-tier slices with no mandatory triggers. BLOCKED verdict prevents auto-advance; CLEAN or NEEDS-FIXES proceed to /build-slice.

reads.purpose: Slice intent, ACs, must-not-defer, out-of-scope, risk tier
Slice design handed to Critic for adversarial review
New ADRs from this slice handed to Critic
Curated cross-slice action points register for Critic context
Most-recent-10 slice table for pattern recognition context
Specific archived reflections when semantic query or register points to a direct match

outputs.purpose: Critic findings, Builder draft dispositions, and user-ratified triage table
Update stage, progress box, current focus, on-resume after critique

agents.name: critique
agents.purpose: Performs adversarial review of mission-brief.md + design.md + ADRs along 9 dimensions, returning findings as critique.md content

tools.name: project_frame_synth
tools.purpose: Synthesizes project Identity/Trajectory/Impact frame to give the Critic strategic-direction context (PFS-1/ADR-080)

tools.name: triage_audit
tools.purpose: Validates critique.md Triage section for required fields, valid verdict, complete disposition rows, and non-empty rationale on OVERRIDDEN/DEFERRED/ESCALATED

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read mission-brief.json, design.json, ADRs, action-points.json, _index.json, triage.json, milestone.json

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write critique.json to the slice folder

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Update milestone.json (stage, progress box, current focus, on-resume)

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run project_frame_synth and triage_audit via $PY (past-lessons lookup now queries the JSON archive directly)

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Step 4.5 TRI-1 user-owned triage — present findings + Builder drafts and halt for user ratification
